card.name: Pollution source wording before industrial
card.fires_on: Words in environmental pollution text where a source of contamination is about to be named, such as 'from', 'and', or the start of 'anthropogenic'. It looks ahead to 'industrial' or 'anthropogenic' sources.

modes.label: Release from sources
modes.description: Linking words like 'from' or 'of' after release, emission or contamination, before the source type.
modes.example: the amount of cadmium that can be released to the air<< from>> waste sites and incinerators so that

modes.label: Inside anthropogenic
modes.description: The opening piece of the word anthropogenic, describing human-made sources of chemicals.
modes.example: most<< anthrop>>ogenic chemicals and waste materials including toxic organic

modes.label: Natural vs man-made contrast
modes.description: Words like 'and' or 'non' in contrasts between natural, industrial, point and dispersed sources.
modes.example: derives from both natural<< and>> anthropogenic sources. Globally, most
